description: Takes a voice off the project's kept voices, by its voiceId (voices_read). A cloned or designed voice is deleted from ElevenLabs for good, which frees one of the plan's voices of its own; a library voice only leaves the list and can be kept again. Refused while a character still speaks in it. Ask the owner before removing their own cloned voice.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: voice_remove
title: Remove a kept voice
